positive.prompt: Remove this local duplication behind the current passing tests without changing behavior or moving any system boundary
Rename and extract this long private Rust function in small verified steps while preserving ownership, errors, ordering, and concurrency
Move this cohesive calculation to the existing module that already owns its data, then rerun focused and regression checks

negative.prompt: Refactor the Rust validation environment by introducing a backend, composition root, service entrypoints, task supervision, and a new end-to-end test boundary
Add this approved behavior from its acceptance example and demonstrate a failing test before implementation
Design exact Rust resource transfer, startup rollback, async cancellation, joining, Drop fallback, and fallible cleanup without implementation

evals.prompt: Behind the current green tests, remove one duplicated private calculation through an independently reviewable transformation. Preserve behavior, ownership, errors, ordering, and concurrency; rerun focused and broader checks; and do not create a design artifact unless durable design knowledge changes.
evals.expected_output: One local behavior-preserving transformation improves the named structural problem and remains protected by focused and regression evidence.
expectations: The observable invariant and green baseline are explicit
One local structural problem bounds the transformation
Focused checks run after the transformation and broader checks remain green
No boundary-sensitive system redesign is hidden inside the refactoring
prohibitions: Do not change required behavior or weaken a valid test
Do not create a new backend, composition root, runtime owner, or test boundary as a local cleanup
Do not create a standalone refactoring record without an independent need
